title: Superspace coinvariants for wreath products
summary: Let $Ω$ be the superspace ring of regular differential forms on the affine space $\mathbb{C}^n$. If $G \subseteq GL_n(\mathbb{C})$ is a complex reflection group, the {\em $G$-superspace coinvariant ring} is the quotient $SR_G := Ω_n/SI_G$ where $SI_G \subseteq Ω$ is the ideal generated by $G$-invariants with vanishing constant term. We study this ring when $G = \mathbb{Z}_r \wr \mathfrak{S}_n$ is the group of $r$-colored permutation matrices.
